translations.web: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
translations.bsb: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
translations.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
translations.asv: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.
